title: 전문심리위원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Management of Candidates)
(1) The Minister of the National Court Administration shall select candidates for expert commissioners from among persons with specialized knowledge and experience and maintain a list of the candidates.
(2) To select candidates for expert commissioners, the Minister of the National Court Administration may request other national agencies, public organizations, educational institutions, research institutes, etc. to recommend candidates.
(3) The Minister of the National Court Administration may add candidates to the list or delete them from the list as necessary.
